question: 在同一行业同一日期，经营财务得分从低到高是否对应逐股后续结果改善，还是仅最高组/组合平均的局部现象？
mechanism: 检视财务排序与后续结果的形状，分清广泛梯度、只发生在一端、无清晰关系及随时期变化。无单调收益梯度不直接推翻已有限成立的GP坏月份证据；单调梯度也不证明因果或预测可迁移。
use: explanatory diagnostic of sealed stock selection; not new confirmation, not actionable portfolio
why_new: P2已保存F/top20比较，但没有完整同业五组排序梯度。用户现在明确扩展选股和稳定流程；原核心及风险跟进不重跑。

selection.sectors: sector_n >=5 and at least 2 distinct scores

partition.input: 每scope/月份/行业，严格复用已保存financial_score，不按回报排序，不额外四舍五入分数制造同分；股票代码仅作输出稳定排序。
partition.eligibility: 行业原n>=5且至少两个不同分数；不再增加最低不同分数数量来追求好看梯度。
partition.algorithm: 按分数从低到高。每个相同分数块有m只股票，在排序位置连续区间[a,a+m]占m个位置。第j组(j=1..5)区间[(j−1)n/5, j*n/5]。令该块与组区间重合长度为L，则块中每只股票给该组的份额alpha=L/m。每只股票五组alpha加总1，同分股票获得完全相同alpha；每组份额总数n/5。
partition.weight: 行业原权重n/N保持。每只股票在第j组的权重=(n/N)*alpha/(n/5)。行业分数相同块可能同时参与相邻组，是公平分摊，无需凭代码拆同分。
partition.raw_contribution: 各组跨支持行业权重和为支持比例S。raw=sum(weight*return)只能称原池中的支持部分贡献，不能称余下现金0收益的实际组合。
partition.conditional_return: S>0时组条件回报=raw/S，全部五组用相同S。支持行业间相对权重保持原n/N，不人为每行业等权。
partition.interpretation: 每组有效人数n/5可非整数，组之间由于相同值存在共同股票份额。五组不是五份独立证据，更不是五套可执行仓位；同分多时曲线平坦可能是度量分辨率低。
support_reports: 每月原N、支持N与S；分别给n<5剔除/常数剔除人数和原权重，不能重复加总。
每行业不同分数个数、跨组同分块原权重、Q1与Q5共同股票份额及实际不同目标权重。
按年度和scope汇总支持，检查2015–2019与2020–2025的资料范围差异；不要换组数补样本。
deterministic_checks: 每股票五组alpha之和1；每同分块所有股票alpha完全相同。
每行业每组alpha之和n/5；每组raw权重和S；条件权重和1。
五组条件回报简单平均严格等于同支持股票按原池等权的supported_P回报（两未知情景分别检查）。
行顺序/股票代码重命名不改变分组金融结果；反转分数时Q1与Q5对应反转。
所有同分/无支持/缺回报/单行业n=5和n=6、边界跨同分、大同分块分别用合成数据检查；不增真实实验。

selection.sector_mass: original n/N kept, excluded sectors counted and not redistributed for raw contribution; also show normalized supported conditional results
selection.quintile_weight: within each sector each group normalized to that sector original n/N; raw sum equals supported mass, conditional sums1; do not count excluded mass as zero-return actual investment
selection.no_changed_portfolios: saved P/M/F/B/D weights checked for each scope/month unit sums, then readonly
selection.same_support_baseline: supported_P from exactly supported stocks; quintile mean must equal supported_P, not sealed full P

outcomes.unknown: same original missing rows zero or -1 without dropping; scenarios not real bounds
outcomes.monthly: raw weighted contribution, supported conditional group returns, top-bottom paired difference percentage points, score rank association optional not included
outcomes.summary: mean each five groups and high-low, positive-month share, annual means, same2015-2019/2020-2025, worst and best month descriptive
outcomes.uncertainty: paired circular month blocks length6 and12, 2000 draws seed20261019; interval 2.5/97.5 percentiles; descriptive already-seen results and multiple scopes, not confirmatory significance; identical circular date block draws across all scopes/scenarios, save draw matrix SHA
outcomes.no_support: retain all132 dates, conditional returns missing not0; each block draw mean supported months only, allmissing draw recorded missing

source_limits: Same P2 qualified financials/version amendment/industry historical proxy, no ETF/trading/cost claims. Tiny and tied supports reported. No optimization or horizons grid.
execution: no real computation until reviewed contract and tool hash frozen

required_changes_adopted: all scopes/scenarios with same draw indices
